name: PREVIOUSLY IN GTM
tagline: A weekly read for founders, GTM leaders and growth marketers.
title: Most AI agents can't finish what they start on your site
standfirst: A long read on why the rush to build go to market for AI agents is outrunning the evidence that agents can act on it, and what to fix this quarter regardless.
cover_sub: Why the rush to build go to market for AI agents is outrunning the evidence that agents can act on it.

insight.label: By the numbers
insight.text: chat only AI agents that finished a real booking task without a browser of their own, in a 20 assistant test.
insight.source: Source: The GTM Engineering Newsletter, reporting AI Search Leaders' flight booking test. Reported, not audited.

quote.label: Worth pinning above your desk
quote.text: Our listing text was the whole storefront.
quote.attribution: Lukas Campos, founder of Audioscape, via The GTM Engineering Newsletter

framework.title: Four questions before an agent-readiness project gets a budget line
framework.subtitle: Ask them in order.
framework.footer: A project that fails all four has not earned this quarter's engineering time.

items.name: Evidence
items.question: Has an agent actually completed this task?
items.example: Not discussed it. Completed it, with evidence shown.

items.name: Control
items.question: Who decides whether you get shown?
items.example: If you cannot request it, you cannot plan around it.

items.name: Cost
items.question: Would you build this page anyway?
items.example: For a human evaluating you at 11pm, not just a model.

items.name: Reversal
items.question: What happens when the platform changes its mind?
items.example: A route that can vanish overnight is upside, not a plan.
